title: Child delegates beyond its own grant
description: Synthetic case: child has read access to resource-A and attempts to delegate read+write to grandchild.
policy_assumptions: child has read access to resource-A and attempts to delegate read+write to grandchild
All identities, resources, and grants are fictional.
No implicit permission expansion is assumed.

constraints: scope is limited by parent authority

expected.rationale: A child may not delegate authority it does not itself possess.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
